The Tenda Animal store in Telheiras is a very well-maintained space, with a modern and organized presentation that makes the shopping experience quite pleasant. It stands out not only for the variety of products available, but also for the way they are displayed, making searching easier.

The biggest difference is, without a doubt, the service. The team is extremely friendly, helpful, and demonstrates solid knowledge, assisting with recommendations tailored to the animals' needs. A genuine care for the customer and the well-being of the pets is evident.

Without a doubt, a benchmark store for those seeking quality, a good atmosphere, and exceptional service.
I really appreciate the friendly service from the store staff.

They used to be 5 stars, but lately they've been disappointing. I have several kittens and I used to buy Felix cat food in 44-unit packs, but now when I go there, it's never available. Today, Thursday, I know there's an article about this product coming, and they tell me it's out of stock and hasn't been coming in. They have an advertisement on the door advertising the product and a promotion. Now I ask, does this only apply to animal welfare associations, and other customers don't get any benefits? I'm a customer of this store. This all happened at the Telheiras store. Here's a photo of the advertisement on the door.

A pet store inside a shopping mall that doesn't allow animals seems ridiculous to me, to say the least. When I arrived at the mall with my little dog, who weighs less than 5 kg, I was escorted by a security guard who made me drive down two or three flights of stairs because entry was only permitted through the parking lot. Already dissatisfied, I arrived at the store and was poorly served by the woman who was hiding in a corner and didn't bother to come out to assist me. I won't be back.
